policies.policyname: Editors create translations of editable news
policies.with_check:
(has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM news n
  WHERE ((n.id = news_translations.news_id) AND ((n.created_by = auth.uid()) OR can_edit_country(auth.uid(), n.country_code))))))

policies.policyname: Public reads approved translations of published news
policies.qual:
((status = 'approved'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM news n
  WHERE ((n.id = news_translations.news_id) AND (n.published = true)))))

functions:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.news_translations_guard_approval()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND NEW.status = 'approved')
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at THEN
    IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solo un administrador puede aprobar traducciones';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER news_translations_guard_approval BEFORE UPDATE ON public.news_translations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION news_translations_guard_approval()
CREATE TRIGGER news_translations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.news_translations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
